paragraphs: Aeries Software makes a student information system for K-12 districts, the record system behind daily district operations. The people it is built for are named as counselors, administrators and technology directors.

The system covers gradebooks, health records, disciplinary records and state reporting, including CALPADS in California and PEIMS in Texas. Around that core sit modules for analytics, family communication, enrollment and payments. Online enrollment brings customizable forms, automated notifications, multi-student enrollment and secure document uploads.

More than 750 districts and local education agencies are said to rely on the system. The customer base is described as districts across California and Texas. The company also says its staff include people with experience in school districts or educational roles. The name comes from aerie, an eagle nest, and the company describes the system as hosted in the cloud.
